Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2 + `target:v18`:** it is the same class and grade as #23909. The v18 anonymous floor promises 401 on these doors, and the standalone server answers 405 / 404 and names the allowed methods to an anonymous caller.
- **Why `domain:cli`:** the mounts are `packages/runtime`. `plugin-sharing`'s share-link routes are declared on the claim. Serial with PR #24009.

Claim: PM loop round 1, serial, p1/p2 only (the maintainer to this seat, verbatim 「串行派发，只处理 p1 p2」; #24022's PR #24132 waits only in the merge queue). Label order read in this act: `target:v18` p2 cards rank ahead of an unboarded p1, #24062 is with triage (`pm:retriage`, `6228573973`), and #24024 is the oldest of the two boarded p2 bugs. #24024: on the standalone server, every anonymous call to an unmounted `/notifications` or `/share-links` verb or path is answered `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` in the dispatcher's standard envelope, as on `createHonoApp` · 2026-10-17T03:13Z
Session: `session_01BVm1pAXVXQ3PjC42j1kPFf`
Account: `os-sales` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)

Worktree: `objectstack-issue-24024`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#1` (seat post #6024)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `c1c0a9094`; line numbers move; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`: the in-app notifications mounts (about `:1366`-`:1401`), and a `/share-links` mount only if the measured route puts the standalone floor there. Shape: PR #24009's `/keys` mounts (`9e797a897`).
- `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`: rows for the new mounts, and the census count `node scripts/check-route-ledger-census.mjs --fix` writes, as seat ruling `6222005517` on #23909 ruled for `/keys`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-routes.ts` (cross-lane on triage's route, `6223692368`; `domain:services`): the anonymous answer on the share-link management faces (about `:349`) and on the paths it does not serve.
- Pins: `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.routes.test.ts`, new `*.hono.integration.test.ts` files beside the precedent's, and `plugin-sharing` tests beside `share-link-routes.ts`. One `.changeset/24024-*.md`.
- ⛔ Hold-offs: `packages/runtime/src/domains/notifications.ts` and `domains/share-links.ts` (the floor itself, ADR-0138 D2); the observability Proxy's verb list (#24025's); the `405` with no `Allow` header (#24023's); `plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts`; `docs/qa/`; any `packages/spec` edit (the `domain:spec` seat's).
Container & model: `M` (two owners of one surface, a mount set, ledger rows, and a measured choice of where the share-link floor answers), `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Basis for the Clause-② line: no request that was accepted becomes refused, and none that was refused becomes accepted. An anonymous call that was refused `405` or `404` is refused `401`, which is already published text in changeset `23225-domain-floor-anonymous-deny` (`.changeset/pre/`, v18): "`/notifications`: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` on every face", and "`/share-links`: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` on the create, list and revoke faces and on every path the domain does not serve". No error code is minted.
Responsibility: `packages/runtime`'s standalone mounts (this lane) and `plugin-sharing`'s share-link routes (domain:services, on triage's cross-lane route) | the domain floor (ADR-0138 D2, `domains/notifications.ts` / `domains/share-links.ts`) already answers 401 first, but only for a verb that reaches it; `createHonoApp`'s catch-all reaches it, the standalone server's explicit mounts do not | an anonymous caller of a standalone or `os dev` server, measured on a stock showcase boot by #23909's dev (`6221942285`, out-of-scope findings 2 and 3)
Thread-read: 6223692368
Serial constraints cleared: the 6 open PRs read in this act; none edits `dispatcher-plugin.ts`, `route-ledger.ts` or `plugin-sharing/`. No open `pm:dispatched` claim declares those files; the only other lane card in flight is this seat's #24022 (`serve.ts`, in the merge queue). The precedent PR #24009 (triage's serial note) merged as `9e797a897`. #24025 (p2, `pm:queue`) and #24023 (p3, `pm:queue`) name `dispatcher-plugin.ts` and the domains' 405s; neither is in flight, and both are held off above. #23952 (`pm:epic`, no claim) is declared on `plugin-sharing`'s seeder, a different region.
